decisions.rationale: ROOT accepts the blocking gap but rejects the submitted fixture-only causal diagnosis. Exact reproduction proves the malformed first request is rejected inside _load before any admission claim; a corrected request reusing that ID then reaches _dispatch once and returns the old immutable REJECTED response. The supported sequential retry path can therefore perform a hidden side effect while reporting rejection, breaking request/response correlation. A small fail-closed response check plus a precise regression is worth its bounded cost and risk.
decisions.smallest_fix: Before creating a new admission claim or dispatching, return an already-published immutable response for the loaded request ID. Update CP01/02 to assert that rejected-ID reuse cannot dispatch, then use a fresh request ID for the accepted-and-identical-replay case. Do not weaken admission claims or replay validation.
